newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkey says Iraq oil transit fee same as in 1990.
newsitem.headline: Turkey says Iraq oil transit fee same as in 1990.

text.p: Turkey said on Friday it would impose the same transit fee as before the 1990 Gulf crisis on Iraqi oil flowing through a pipeline passing through its territory under the U.N. oil-for-food deal.

A senior energy ministry official, who declined to be named, told Reuters the pipeline, to be used for most of the Iraqi oil exports under the U.N. plan, was fully ready for pumping oil out to the markets.
He said it was not immediately possible to comment on the quality of the oil trapped inside the pipeline for more than six years, and only tests could establish this.
He said Turkey's state oil refiner Tupras would buy 2.1 million tonnes from the Iraqi oil sales over six months, as agreed in the summer with the Iraqi government.
